instruction: Authorized security audit of the owner's OWN app (UniGoat: static HTML/JS/Capacitor + Supabase backend). Focus on: Supabase RLS/authorization gaps in supabase/migrations, exposed secrets or service_role keys in www/ client code, auth bypass, IDOR in coupon redemption (public.self_redeem) and www/admin.html admin functions, XSS in user-rendered content. Prioritize real, exploitable findings.
